label: sec:p3-blowup-yekutieli-intro
title: Blowup as a finite obstruction level
html: We identify finite-time Navier-Stokes (NS) blowup with a finite obstruction level n^* in the brane tower. At this level, a velocity field ceases to lift. We encode a counter-example by the cohomological address (v_0, T^*, \Sigma, n^*, \kappa_{n^*}). The local cohomology at the unit defect z=1 controls the singular set \Sigma.
